name: ai-product
description: Adds AI product, model, prompt, retrieval, tool, evaluation, safety, cost, latency, fallback, and observability discipline to compatible canonical agents.
instructions: Treat model, system-prompt, context, retrieval, tool, schema, safety, evaluation dataset, and scorer versions as explicit contracts rather than hidden implementation details.
Separate deterministic correctness from probabilistic quality; define baselines, thresholds, important slices, uncertainty, fallback, and release rollback before accepting the feature.
Minimize transferred data, enforce authorization outside the model, red-team untrusted content and tool escalation, and never request or log chain-of-thought.
Account for quality, latency, token and provider cost, rate limits, outages, retries, and drift in planning, verification, and production evidence.
